identity.signature: pub fn identity(mut self, object: &str, morphism: &str) -> Self

identity_checked.signature: pub fn identity_checked(mut self, object: &str, morphism: &str) -> Result<Self, String>
identity_checked.body: { if let Some((src, tgt)) = self.category.boundary_of(morphism) { if src != object || tgt != object { return Err(format!( "Cannot set {} as identity of {}: boundary is {} â†’ {}", morphism, object, src, tgt )); } } else { self.category.add_morphism(morphism, object, object); } self.category.set_identity(object, morphism); Ok(self) }
identity_checked.obligation: If arrow exists, refuse when either endpoint differs from supplied object, preserving full message payload. If absent, create the requested loop. Then set the raw identity binding. This is only boundary admission, not unit-law certification. On error the consumed builder is dropped, not returned as a partial value.

identity_object.signature: pub fn identity_object(mut self, object: &str) -> Self
identity_object.body: { let id = format!("id_{}", object); self.category.add_morphism(&id, object, object); self.category.set_identity(object, &id); self }
identity_object.obligation: Format exact id_ prefix plus object; insert loop and binding with that name. Formatting is a deterministic recipe, not collision avoidance or an automatic mathematical identity proof.

composition.signature: pub fn composition(mut self, first: &str, second: &str, composite: &str) -> Self
composition.obligation: Raw overwrite of ordered (first,second)->composite, where second follows first. No endpoint, totality or associativity check.

path_composition.signature: pub fn path_composition(mut self, f: &str, g: &str, composite: &str) -> Self
path_composition.obligation: Same raw overwrite convention with argument names f,g. Preserve order g after f.

identity_compositions.body: { let DeclaredFiniteCategory { morphisms, identities, compositions, .. } = &mut self.category; // Borrow separate maps; only owned table keys/new values need copies. for morphism in morphisms.values() { if let Some(source_id) = identities.get(&morphism.source) { compositions .entry((source_id.clone(), morphism.name.clone())) .and_modify(|value| value.clone_from(&morphism.name)) .or_insert_with(|| morphism.name.clone()); } if let Some(target_id) = identities.get(&morphism.target) { compositions .entry((morphism.name.clone(), target_id.clone())) .and_modify(|value| value.clone_from(&morphism.name)) .or_insert_with(|| morphism.name.clone()); } } self }
identity_compositions.obligation: Borrow morphisms/identities immutably and compositions mutably through disjoint fields. Visit the same BTreeMap value order as old cloned snapshot. For each morphism, source identity entry update precedes target identity entry update. Present identities set exact ordered keys to the morphism name; missing ones do nothing. Entry modify/insert has the same logical overwrite semantics, including deterministic last-write wins on raw collisions. Other fields and unrelated table entries remain unchanged.
